## It was the stability analysis techniques of Bode and Nyquist
in the 30's that made control engineering @ subject area « oo
later progress may be measured in terms of increasing

To my mind the development of techniques for the study of
stability and sensitivity (general 'robustness') is the major
determinant of the success of any field of applied system

2.1 Linear Systems Theory

between the theoretical sub-structures of CE and AI in one

systems". The role of linear systems theory in CE cannot be
over-emphasized ~ It is both the major strength of the whole

constraint that leads to deep and elegant results - that they
are applicable to physical systems is metaphysical magic

AI. We chose the systems to be controlled, usually

{e) We certainly chose the controllers and, with the

controller tends to make the whole system appear linear. -

explains the lack of impact of such theory in Af where we
rarely deal with the dynamics of physical systems and choose
our problem areas with different theoretical models in mind.
